summary: The candidate is message and test hardening only. It does not add a CompressedTensorsW4A16Sparse24 scheme, weight loader, sparse kernel, or execution path. The exact original-contract configuration still raises ImportError, while another valid-looking representation silently selects the dense CompressedTensorsWNA16 scheme despite 2:4 metadata.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e36a335c290f/venv/bin/python < base W4A16 sparse-24 scheme-selection reproducer
tests.what_was_measured: On base 358c1632, reproduced the reported ImportError for groupwise INT4 weight-only quantization with sparse-24-bitmask format and 2:4 sparsity metadata.
At exact candidate b1b2f71e, all seven candidate CPU tests passed; they validate current mixed-format selection and error wording, not W4A16 2:4 support.

The original W4A16 sparse-24 case still raised ImportError; pack-quantized W4A16 plus 2:4 metadata returned dense CompressedTensorsWNA16; unquantized 2:4 explicitly raised unsupported; a non-sparse dense W4A16 case exercised only the improved message.

gpu_evidence: rocm-smi identified the assigned GPU as AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950. Torch is 2.11.0+rocm7.2 with HIP 7.2.26015. No NVIDIA Sparse-Marlin/CUTLASS execution or independent sparse numerical reference was possible.
remaining_counterexamples: A W4A16 groupwise INT4 configuration with top-level sparse-24-bitmask format and 2:4 sparsity metadata still raises ImportError at the candidate commit.
A mixed/per-group pack-quantized W4A16 configuration with the same 2:4 metadata returns CompressedTensorsWNA16, which does not implement the requested sparse execution contract.
An unquantized 2:4 sparse configuration reaches an explicit error stating that compressed-tensors 2:4 sparsity is unsupported.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GPU was available for native sparse-kernel compilation, ISA inspection, or independent numerical validation; the assigned architecture was AMD gfx950.
The candidate changed no native source, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The reported 26B Gemma weights were not downloaded or served; NEXTN, full model loading, HTTP transport, and semantic accuracy remain unverified.
The current public model config may have changed since the original report, but that does not satisfy the open feature request or invalidate the deterministic configuration-level failure.
